text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.28 for the Senior Software Engineer position. The strongest evidence of their qualifications includes their background in "Node.js", "React", and "AWS", as well as holding a computer science degree. Key gaps include a lack of experience with python and vue.js, as well as having only 2.5 years of experience compared to the implied requirement of 4 years. Despite these missing must-have skills and a low overall fit, the application has been escalated for further review.
